title: Assetzaar Marketplace
description: Search Assetzaar's catalog of UI components, agent skills, SaaS kits and automations.
summary: Search Assetzaar's catalog of UI components, agent skills, SaaS kits and automations.
offersHint: Search Assetzaar's catalog of UI components, agent skills, SaaS kits and automations. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://assetzaar.com/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search
toolsPreview.description: Search the whole Assetzaar marketplace (agent skills, UI components, production modules, SaaS kits, automations and services). Returns machine-readable manifests with type, price, security-scan status, compatibility and install command. Use this to find a product to build with.

toolsPreview.name: inspect
toolsPreview.description: Get the full machine-readable manifest for one product by slug — type, version, author (verified?), license, price, dependencies, security-scan status, compatibility and install command — so you can evaluate it before installing.

toolsPreview.name: search_components
toolsPreview.description: Search Assetzaar's marketplace for UI components by name, category or technology. Returns matches with slugs and install commands.

toolsPreview.name: get_component
toolsPreview.description: Get a component by slug. Free components return installable source. With an agent key (Authorization: Bearer azr_…), paid components the account owns and Pro components covered by an active membership return source too. Otherwise returns how to buy (see the `purchase` tool).

toolsPreview.name: install
toolsPreview.description: Install any agent-installable Assetzaar product by slug. Free products return source or a short-lived signed download URL. Paid products require an agent key plus ownership; Pro products require an agent key plus active membership. For paid products, call purchase/check_purchase first.

toolsPreview.name: purchase
toolsPreview.description: Start a purchase of a paid Assetzaar product for the connected account. Requires an agent key (Authorization: Bearer azr_…, created at assetzaar.com/account/agent-keys). Returns a Stripe approval URL — the HUMAN must open it and approve payment; the agent can never charge anyone by itself. After approval, call check_purchase, then install.

toolsPreview.name: check_purchase
toolsPreview.description: Check whether a purchase started with the `purchase` tool has been approved and paid. Returns status: pending | paid | expired. Once paid, the entitlement is granted and install returns the source or signed download URL.
